base_member_text: [L12-L15] (LOW/error-handling) The invoked test program’s exit status is never checked and output files are overwritten on each iteration, leaving pass/fail and diagnostic retention contracts unclear.
audit_member_text: [L12-L19] (MED/exit-status) The program's exit status is neither saved nor returned and subsequent logging and deletion commands can hide test execution failures from the caller.

base_member_text: [L11-L15] (MED/loop/termination) The test runner repeats the program while `ftnunit.lst` exists without a timeout, iteration limit, or exit-status check, so a stale list file or non-terminating test can loop indefinitely.
audit_member_text: [L12-L15] (MED/termination) The restart loop has no progress or failure check, so a stale ftnunit.lst combined with a launch failure or repeated crash can loop indefinitely.

adversarial.rationale: Indefinite relaunch remains possible for launch failures or repeated failures before the framework advances or removes ftnunit.lst, but ordinary crashes inside successive tests are not sufficient. ftnunit.f90:109-120 checkpoints each test before calling it, lines 228-238 restore that checkpoint so the next run skips the crashed test, and runtests_final removes the list at line 177; the batch loop lacks protection only when this progress/cleanup mechanism cannot complete.
